properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks

properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks

properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks
properties.description: "Virtual Disk used for the action, for example in a storage move

properties.name: newEntity

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. properties.name: entityCharacteristics

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID

properties.name: newLocation

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: externalActionName

properties.name: externalActionUrl

properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks
properties.description: "Virtual Disk used for the action, for example in a storage move

properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks
properties.description: "Virtual Disk used for the action, for example in a storage move

properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks
properties.description: "Virtual Disk used for the action, for example in a storage move

properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
properties.description: Target entity for an action. For example, the VM in a Resize Action, or the host for a VM move

properties.name: virtualDisks
properties.description: "Virtual Disk used for the action, for example in a storage move

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. properties.name: actionImpactID
properties.description: ID for the action, which will persist across restarts"

properties.name: currentEntity
properties.description: Current entity e.g. the current host that a VM resides on for a VM move action

properties.name: currentLocation
properties.description: The region (DataCenter) where the current service entity is located, for cloud migration actions

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: A user readable name of the api object. Cannot be blank. The UTF-8 encoding must be at most 255 bytes."

properties.name: entityCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: executionCharacteristics
properties.description: Characteristics of the execution of the Action. Include disruptiveness and reversibility.

properties.name: marketID
properties.description: Market ID associated with the requested items

properties.name: newEntity
properties.description: Destination entity, such as the host that a VM will move to for a VM move action

properties.name: newLocation
properties.description: The region, represented as a DataCenter entity, where the target service entity will be located for cloud migration actions

properties.name: prerequisites
properties.description: Description(s) of any prerequisite(s) that must occur before execution is possible. If this field is populated, the action would otherwise be executable but has been blocked by this prerequisite, and is displayed accordingly. If this field is not populated, no prerequisite has caused the action mode to be modified, and the action is displayed as normal.

properties.name: prioritizedAutomationOpportunities
properties.description: generated using the Prioritze Automationsetting, indicating that it is possible to have more savings if these opportunities are satisfied

properties.name: relatedSettingsPolicies
properties.description: The related settings policies associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstance
properties.description: The Reserved Instance associated with the action

properties.name: reservedInstancePlatform
properties.description: The platform of the recommended RI if the action has a supersaving

properties.name: externalActionName
properties.description: name under which this action appears in third-party software or external approval backend

properties.name: externalActionUrl
properties.description: URL to third-party software showing this action. Suitable for external action approval

properties.name: target
